blocking.issue: Residual from the previous L2-2. The missing-usage row now charges 'All of R for that attempt'. That charges R again for every attempt that lacks usage, so one request can be charged up to (retries.attempts + 1) x candidates x R, plus the usage of the attempt that succeeded. Pack 8.9 and the System overview charge the whole reservation once when usage is missing. The text says row 2 'applies pack 8.9' and applies it now, even though OQ-ai-llm-gateway-15 lists 'per-attempt settlement' as a proposed amendment that has not landed. The other proposals (guard tolerance, nothing for error statuses, larger of R and partial usage) are correctly held back with 'neither applies before it closes'. Row 3 ('Nothing, proposed') also gives no rule for the time before OQ-ai-llm-gateway-15 closes, and line 324 does not list it among the held-back proposals, so M3 behavior is ambiguous there.
blocking.evidence: L316: "Rows 1 and 2 apply pack 8.9, row 2 per attempt:"; L321: "| Attempt reached the provider, no usage read | Error status, `perTryTimeout`, stream error, interruption, client disconnect before or after commit, `RZ-AI-013` | All of R for that attempt |"; L322: "| No provider attempt after reservation | Guardrail block, `RZ-AI-004`, Semantic Cache hit | Nothing, proposed (OQ-ai-llm-gateway-15; hits: OQ-ai-llm-gateway-5) |"; L324: "neither applies before it closes"; L206: "at most (`retries.attempts` + 1) x candidates attempts"; L617 OQ-15: "per-attempt settlement". Pack 8.9: "When usage is missing (interrupted stream, no usage reported), charge all of R". System overview L268: "or charges the whole reservation when usage is missing".
blocking.fix: (1) Change row 2's charge to 'All of R, once per request (pack 8.9)', so a request is never charged more than R when any attempt lacks usage. (2) Rewrite L316 as 'Rows 1 and 2 apply pack 8.9'. (3) Extend L324 to say that charging R per attempt and charging nothing without an attempt (row 3) are also OQ-ai-llm-gateway-15 proposals that do not apply before it closes. Either make row 3 read 'All of R (pack 8.9); nothing is proposed', or state its interim rule explicitly. (4) Keep 'per-attempt settlement' in the OQ-ai-llm-gateway-15 question, reworded as 'charging R per attempt that lacks usage', so the proposal stays recorded.

non_blocking.suggestion: The Overshoot bound adds 'hidden reasoning above C on `gemini` and `ollama`' to pack 8.9's bound. It is scoped to OQ-ai-llm-gateway-17, but consider adding a pack 8.9 Overshoot-bound amendment to the OQ-ai-llm-gateway-15 or -17 options, so the pack row and this document do not drift.

L515 calls `ruralz_ai_abandoned_attempts_total`, `ruralz_ai_failed_attempts_total`, `ruralz_ai_semantic_cache_store_skipped_total` and the reasons `abandoned`, `error_status` and `oversized` 'New proposals'. docs/architecture/10-observability.md (L376-L382) already lists all of them. Reword to 'Observability has adopted ...' to avoid stale cross-document state. Note too that Observability gives `ruralz_ai_usage_missing_total` the unit 'requests', while settlement here is per attempt.

Committing headers at the first content event (L124) extends the System overview lifecycle ('onResponse on headers', 'response headers, now committed'). It is recorded in OQ-ai-llm-gateway-15. Consider saying explicitly that it is proposed until the amendment lands, for the same reason as the guard tolerance.

foundation_amendments: Pack 8.9 Settlement row: define settlement across several attempts (Provider Fallback or retries). The proposal under OQ-ai-llm-gateway-15 is to charge summed provider usage and to charge all of R once when any attempt lacks usage. Charging R per attempt, charging nothing when no attempt was made or the status was an error, and charging the larger of R and partial usage stay options until the amendment lands.
Pack 8.9 Overshoot bound row: consider noting hidden-reasoning overshoot on dialects whose cap does not bound reasoning (OQ-ai-llm-gateway-17).
